post.content:
Last week I got to do a fireside chat at #UKHouse during SXSW London with Ameeta Virk MBE from Department for Business and Trade

Ameeta kindly gave us a spotlight to showcase Alvalan and the progress we're making as we start onboarding private customers 🙌🙌. But she was also super keen to spotlight the founder journey, from fashion, to gaming, to building technology that puts fashion into games easily.

One of the most thought-provoking questions was, "How do you build a tech product knowing nothing about technology?"

Simple enough, but honestly, it's been very hard. I've made mistakes, burnt money, tried things that haven't worked, restarted, and pivoted more times than I've had hot dinners.

But ultimately, building a business is more than technology. Innovation is about building new business models and solving problems for customers. We are doing that and technology is an enabler to get there. 

"In order to create the future you have to build it" as Druker once said. 

I've also been fortunate enough to find my tribe and build a great team that's helped me get here. I am still bamboozled by tech, but it's a LOT easier now than it was three years ago. 

Excited to share more soon.

Nirmala Shome Hammed Arowosegbe Tim Ellis John Thornewill Parisa Shahbazi Alice Khor Philippe Spira Constantinos P. Rosamund O.David Patteson  
#innovation
